Request a Refund for Yano Apps Purchases
All purchases from Yano Image and Yano Music are eligible for a full refund when
requests are made within 24 hours of purchase. You may request a refund online
by following these steps.
1. Sign in to your Yano account at yano.com.
2. Go to the drop-down menu titled "What Is the Issue?" and select "Refunds."
3. Choose the app or subscription for which you desire a refund.
4. Describe the reason you are requesting a refund.
Refund requests take up to 48 hours to process. Please note that once your refund
request is processed, you will lose access to the app or subscription immediately.
